io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility

Class PotionCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility.PotionCompat

  • public final class PotionCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Java-8 universal port: compatibility helpers for the base-potion API that does not exist at the 1.8.8 compile floor.

    PotionMeta#getBasePotionData/setBasePotionData (and the PotionData class) arrived in 1.9, while getBasePotionType/setBasePotionType replaced them in 1.20.2. PotionType#isExtendable/isUpgradeable are likewise absent on legacy. All are reached reflectively so the code compiles against 1.8.8 while keeping full behaviour on modern servers.

        public static void setBasePotionData(org.bukkit.inventory.meta.PotionMeta meta,
                                     org.bukkit.potion.PotionType type,
                                     boolean extended,
                                     boolean upgraded)
        Builds a PotionData reflectively from its components and applies it, so callers never reference the PotionData type directly in their bytecode. PotionData only exists from 1.9 onwards; on a 1.8 server this is a no-op (the potion simply keeps no base potion data).
        Parameters:
        meta - The PotionMeta to modify
        type - The PotionType
        extended - Whether the potion is extended
        upgraded - Whether the potion is upgraded
